descriptions.zh: 该操作可以让用户在灵骏连接创建和删除流程失败的情况下，重新尝试该操作。只有在创建失败和删除失败状态的灵骏连接才能重试
descriptions.en: This operation allows the user to retry the operation if the Lingjun connection creation and deletion processes fail. Only the Lingjun connection in the creation failure and deletion failure state can be retried

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eflo retry-vcc --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vcc-id vcc-cn-zvp2w222001 --region cn-hangzhou
